title: Basis Rigidity of the AES S-box and Generic Rigidity of Inversion under Affine Transformations
summary: The AES S-box is constructed from finite field inversion followed by a fixed affine transformation. Since inversion possesses intrinsic Frobenius symmetries among its coordinate realizations, we study how these basis symmetries are altered by outer affine transformations. We first develop a deterministic rigidity criterion for transformed inversion and apply it to the AES S-box. This shows that the linear part of the AES S-box affine transformation alone makes the transformed inversion map basis rigid.
